label: PF Backlog 569
title: Grooming: restamp (light) + regroom (full, change-aware) + claim self-heal on architecture-stale
body:
## Problem / why
An architecture/config change flips every COMPLETE analysis to STALE (global arch fingerprint), so items become
ineligible and `/wg work` returns "no eligible item" - a manual, multi-command re-groom is needed, and the
analysis-only restamp never updates the item context.

## Goal & value
Two clear verbs + seamless claiming:
- `restamp`  (LIGHT): accept the current architecture for stale items - write the current arch_fingerprint,
  NO re-analysis, NO context change (for benign changes). Reasoned + logged.
- `regroom`  (FULL): re-groom stale/context-missing items - AI default (deterministic fallback); when the
  architecture changed the context is UPDATED (force re-derive); when context is missing it is gap-filled;
  approval gate (`--approve`); the change is recorded in the engineering change log.
- Claim self-heal: when nothing is claimable ONLY because items are 'analysis stale (architecture changed)',
  `claim_next` auto-regrooms those items (deterministic, approved) and retries once - never for other blockers.

## Surface
`/pf backlog restamp [all|<epic-id>|<item-id>] [--reason ...] [--limit N]`
`/pf backlog regroom  [all|<epic-id>|<item-id>] [--no-ai] [--limit N] [--approve]`
`core.grooming.restamp(...)`, `core.grooming.regroom(...)`; `core.job_manager.claim_next` self-heals.

## Acceptance (G/W/T)
- Given a stale item, when `restamp`, then it is COMPLETE again with no context change.
- Given a stale/context-missing item, when `regroom`, then analysis+context are refreshed and (with --approve) COMPLETE.
- Given nothing claimable but items blocked only by architecture-stale, when `wg work`, then it auto-regrooms and claims.

## Out of scope (follow-ups)
Change-aware AI prompt (feed the changed arch files); relevance-scoped staleness; narrow `arch_significant`.
